on FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID

mapper.select:
select MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID feeId, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_NAME feeName, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE feeType, temp.YIELD * 100 feeRate, MST_FEEINFO.BASIS basis, MST_FEEINFO.BASIC_BILL basicBill from FIN_CASH_INFO inner join MST_FEEINFO on FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID and MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE in (#{feeTypeTrust}, #{feeTypeFix}, #{feeTypeSale}) left join ( select FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.YIELD from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE inner join (select CASH_ID, max(EFF_DATE) EFF_DATE from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE where EFF_DATE <= #{platDate} and FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} group by CASH_ID) finCashCalcRule on FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = finCashCalcRule.EFF_DATE and FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID = finCashCalcRule.CASH_ID) temp on FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = temp.CASH_ID WHERE FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
and FIN_CASH_INFO.BRANCH = #{branch}

SELECT PRD_LAYER_PARAM.PROD_STYLE PRODTYPE, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID FINPRODID FROM PRD_LAYER_PARAM WHERE PRD_LAYER_PARAM.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by PRD_LAYER_PARAM.Finprod_Id

SELECT PRD_LAYER_PARAM.PROD_STYLE PRODTYPE, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.LAST_AMT LASTAMT, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.LAST_RED LASTRED, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.LAST_AMT_SUB LASTAMTSUB, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT CURRENTSUB, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.ACCOUNTING_AMT ACCOUNTINGAMT, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID FINPRODID FROM PRD_LAYER_PARAM inner JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by PRD_LAYER_PARAM.Finprod_Id

select NVL(INTERF_PROD_INFO.TOTALDRAWAMOUNT, 0) + NVL(INTERF_PROD_INFO.PREINAMOUNT, 0) lastAmt, INTERF_PROD_INFO.TOTALBUYAMOUNT currentSub, NVL(INTERF_PROD_INFO.TOTALDRAWAMOUNT, 0) lastRed, NVL(INTERF_PROD_INFO.PREINAMOUNT, 0) lastAmtSub, INTERF_PROD_INFO.TOTALCURRENTAMOUNT accountingAmt from INTERF_PROD_INFO inner join FIN_PRODUCT on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = INTERF_PROD_INFO.PRODID and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} where to_date(INTERF_PROD_INFO.STARTDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_date(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and INTERF_PROD_INFO.INTERF_ID IN ('449181','449191','449194','449188')

select BRANCHID branch, BANKNAME branchName, BRANCHACCOUNTAMOUNT prinAmt, BRANCHBUYNUM customNum from INTERF_BRANCH inner join FIN_PRODUCT on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = INTERF_BRANCH.PRODID and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} where to_date(INTERF_BRANCH.CDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_date(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and INTERF_BRANCH.INTERF_ID IN ('449181','449191','449194','449188')

select PA_BRANCH_SALE_DETAIL.BRANCH branch, MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_NAME branchName, PRIN_AMT prinAmt, CUSTOM_NUM customNum from PA_BRANCH_SALE_DETAIL left join MST_COUNTER_PARTY on PA_BRANCH_SALE_DETAIL.BRANCH = MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID where TRADE_ID = #{bussId}
mapper.update: delete from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and BRANCH = #{branch}
delete from FIN_CASH_INFO where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and BRANCH = #{branch}
delete from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and BRANCH = #{branch}
mapper.select: select count(*) from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL where TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.totle_trade_id not like '%R%'

select count(1) from trd_product_deal where ps like 'T%' AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND IS_CANCEL = 'N' and trade_id in ( select t.trade_id from trd_product_deal_add t where t.portfolio_id = #{finprodId} )
AND TRADE_DATE > to_date(#{vdate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
